name: /system-scan
description: Full system health check — read-only analysis for a senior engineer new to the project

steps.action: Read codebase and produce system report
steps.context: Read application code, architecture docs, requirements, QA/testing docs, project memory, and control files. Produce a single report answering: 1) What is this system? 2) What's complete? 3) What's in progress? 4) What's planned next? 5) Where does next work belong? 6) Documented risks/gaps/open decisions? Written for a senior engineer new to the system. Strictly read-only — no file modifications, no memory updates, no invented roadmap items.
